batch_norm_semantics.hook_replacement: the forward hook returns approximated Q16 alpha*x+offset, so it replaces each selected BN output

P1.finding: The current M235 Q16 candidate worsens paired mean AEE by 1.730869% and DSEC Fl by 6.892239%; 7/10 AEE frames and 6/10 Fl frames lose.
P1.action: Keep valid825 admission false for this exact configuration. A full 825-frame run would be diagnostic only, not a candidate-admission run.

P1.finding: PyTorch computes current-batch mean and biased variance; only the coefficient recurrence and affine output are approximated.
P1.action: Do not call this a complete dynamic-BN hardware result. Treat sum/sumsq, division and moment storage as a separate hardware milestone.

P1.finding: The remote manifest seals the payloads and selected top-level sources but not every imported model/dataloader/overlay source, Python package version, CUDA/cuDNN version or deterministic-kernel setting.
P1.action: For the next GPU gate, emit a transitive source manifest, pip/conda inventory, GPU/driver/CUDA inventory and deterministic-settings receipt.

P1.finding: The 24 targets and aggregate totals are consistent, but the runtime receipt has no per-module per-sample hook-call, error or immediate event-flip counters.
P1.action: Add a 24-by-sample receipt with calls, coefficient pairs, output values, error percentiles, sn1/sn2 event flips and threshold margins.

P1.finding: All ten frames are contiguous samples from one sequence and the pre-run contract says only that deltas must be safe; it does not freeze numeric AEE/Fl limits. The descriptive paired t-ratios are not a population-significance claim.
P1.action: Freeze numeric screening thresholds and a disjoint ten-frame holdout before selecting the next precision candidate; then promote only one frozen candidate to valid825.

P2.finding: The producer analyzer reports 24 FFN BN modules but does not validate candidate_receipt.target_modules; this independent audit validates the exact 12 BN1 plus 12 BN2 names.
P2.action: Port the exact target-list validation into the next producer analyzer.

P2.finding: The producer analyzer checks the reference status/counts but does not compare its complete identity dictionary to the frozen config/checkpoint/upstream hashes.
P2.action: Validate the complete reference receipt identity, schema and mode.

P2.finding: The producer analyzer computes layer deltas over the intersection of profile keys instead of first requiring equal 93-layer key sets.
P2.action: Require exact layer-key equality before computing spike deltas.

P2.finding: The producer relocation parser relies on the sealed manifest SHA but does not independently reject traversal components or duplicate paths.
P2.action: Retain the manifest SHA and also reject absolute relocated suffixes, '..' components and duplicates.

P2.finding: PASS_PAIRED_S10_NEGATIVE_DOWNSTREAM_ACCURACY_GATE means the evidence passed while the candidate failed; the wording is easy to misread.
P2.action: Use separate evidence_status=PASS and candidate_admission=FAIL fields.

algorithm_feedback: Do not use total spike count as the optimization target: it changes only 0.011660% while AEE and Fl regress materially. Record spatially aligned event flips and recurrent threshold margins instead.
The largest downstream spike delta is in preds.3.sn, so rank the 24 FFN BN sites by their immediate sn1/sn2 flips and by their propagated effect on late decoder/prediction layers.
Allocate precision selectively: keep insensitive modules at the cheap format and widen or bypass only sensitive BN1/BN2 sites.
If hardware-only mixed precision cannot pass, use quantization-aware fine-tuning with the exact LUT/Newton recurrence; that becomes a new checkpoint-bound algorithm-hardware experiment.

next_precision_dse_boundary.scope: Only the 24 FFN BN coefficient-plus-affine hooks; keep checkpoint, first-ten order, no-running BN moments, all other operators and evaluator semantics frozen.
recommended_candidates: Q16 invstd with Q18 alpha/offset, 64-entry LUT, one Newton step
Q18 invstd/alpha/offset, 64-entry LUT, one Newton step
Q18 invstd/alpha/offset, 64-entry LUT, two Newton steps
stage- or module-selective Q18/exact bypass chosen only from immediate event-flip sensitivity
required_receipt_extensions: 24 per-module hook calls for every sample
per-module coefficient pairs, output values, rails and error percentiles
immediate sn1/sn2 event flips and threshold-margin histograms
same paired AEE, DSEC Fl, AAE and spike metrics
transitive source and software environment manifest

proposed_pre_registered_screening_limits.note: These are review recommendations and must be frozen before the sweep, not selected after observing it.

selection_protocol: Use the current frozen first ten only for bounded DSE ranking.
Evaluate the cheapest passing candidate on one predeclared disjoint ten-frame holdout without retuning.
Promote exactly one frozen candidate to valid825 only after both gates pass.
If no candidate passes, stop hardware-only precision tuning and begin an explicitly new exact-recurrence QAT checkpoint line.
